# [Baseline] - WIN - D - AVD Start and Search

Stops Start and Search on the AVD session hosts from fetching anything from the cloud or the web when they open: no search of cloud sources (OneDrive, SharePoint), no search highlights and no list of recently added apps.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | Own — the Search and Start settings from the Settings Catalog (Policy CSP), all three with windowsMultiSession in their applicability |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_AVD_Start_and_Search.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_AVD_Start_and_Search.json) |

> Web results in Search (donotusewebresults) are not in here: [Baseline] - WIN - D - Windows Feature Configuration (class alle) already turns them off on every Windows device — option 0, *Not allowed*, the double negative of Do Not Use Web Results. Searching cloud sources (allowcloudsearch) does come here from that policy: it was removed there, otherwise it would conflict on the session host. The Start setting HideRecommendedSection (hide the whole Recommended section) does not exist in the Settings Catalog of the test tenant; only HideRecentlyAddedApps can be set through Intune. Search highlights (allowsearchhighlights) is a plain integer, 0 = off.
